item.title: Discharge poll duties with professionalism
item.description: Ahead of the 13th National Parliament Election, Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman has directed all officers and soldiers of the Bangladesh Army to discharge their duties with professionalism, impartiality, and strict adherence to legal and constitutional obligations.The directive was issued during the 'Officers' Address' held at Dhaka Cantonment on Sunday, with participation from officers outside Dhaka joining via online platform. item.title: Govt brings students into 'Yes' referendum drive
item.description: In a move to encourage student participation in favour of a 'Yes' vote in the upcoming July referendum, authorities have announced a comprehensive awareness campaign across all universities, colleges, schools, and madrasas in the country.The announcement was made on Sunday by Mahbubur Rahman Tuhin, Senior Information Officer at the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education. item.title: 21 killed, dozens injured in two high-speed trains collision

item.title: South Africa declares a national disaster over flooding, severe weather
item.description: South Africa on Sunday declared a national disaster over torrential rains and floods that have killed at least 30 people in the northern part of the country and damaged thousands of homes and washed away roads and bridges.The declaration was made by the head of the National Disaster Management Center and announced by the government. item.title: Final decision on Bangladesh's participation in T20 WC on Jan 21
item.description: A final call on Bangladesh's participation in the 2026 T20 World Cup and specifically whether they travel to India for the event, is set to be taken by January 21.The ICC informed the BCB of the deadline during their discussions in Dhaka on Saturday (January 17), reports ESPNcricinfo.During the discussion, the BCB reiterated its stance of wanting to play in the T20 World Cup, but outside India.
